captions: If fear for your home enters your mind as evening settles, let this word protect you.
Hear what the Lord declares over your life today: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
Heavenly Father, enclose this household with your holy consuming presence against every silent danger.
Be an impenetrable ring of divine defense surrounding every room and every quiet corner.
Dwell in our midst with your radiant glory, driving out darkness and granting deep peace.
Subscribe to walk under God's covenant shield.
